page.notes: Printed mark (small ornament or reference sign) before "Atque" in the verse, not transcribed. Small dot at the left margin beside "tem intingi" and a star-like mark beside the catchword "minum": printer's or scan marks, not text. Greek passages are hard to read on the scan; the Greek words marked [?] are best readings and should be checked against the original. "as" in "as non erat" is doubtful. Italic and roman distinctions in the Latin quotations are read from the scan. The dots in "......." are printed in the lacuna and kept as printed. "defideraríque" carries an acute accent on the i that may be a printing error. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout.
